note: Generated by tools/assets/icon-catalog (npm run icons:catalog). Do not edit by hand.

style.look: Painted metal-and-enamel icons in the style of the delivered interface art (assets-source/ui/sheets/resource-status-icon-pack.png): warm gold rims, deep blue and bronze, soft top-left light, a subtle dark outline so the icon reads on dark panels.
style.background: Transparent PNG, no baked-in frame or square backdrop (the game draws sockets, frames and rarity borders).
style.readability: Must read at 24 px (resource bar, cost lists) and look good at 96–128 px (hero screen, encyclopedia). One clear silhouette, no text or letters.
style.palette: Shared icons stay neutral (gold, bronze, ivory, deep blue). Pantheon icons use the pantheon accent: Greek #3b73d9, Norse #7fb3d9, Egyptian #2aa3a8, Japanese #d0453f, Celtic #4f9f5c, Mesoamerican #d9772f (each pantheon’s theme accent).
style.naming: Name each file exactly as its asset ID plus .png (for example icon.spell.rune_of_tyr.png). Delivered files replace the stand-ins by asset ID only — no screen changes (ASSET_PIPELINE.md §11).
style.originality: Original designs only: no logos, no characters or symbols from other games, films or brands.

sections.title: Interface icons
sections.intro: Every icon name the interface draws through `Icon` (`packages/ui/src/assets/icons.tsx`). Names with art today show the owner-supplied art; the rest show a simple SVG glyph and are the first to replace. Asset IDs starting `icon.ui.` are the IDs for icons that have no art yet: art delivered under that ID replaces the glyph automatically (`iconArt`).

sections.title: Spells
sections.intro: 54 spells. Each spell has its own icon ID; until it exists the game shows the icon of its effect family (`SPELL_EFFECT_ART`). Pantheon spells should carry their pantheon's palette; shared spells stay neutral.
sections.size: 128 × 128 px PNG, transparent, round-socket safe (keep the subject inside a 110 px circle)

rows.name: Blessing
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Blessing: a weapon edge glowing white-hot. A priest touches a spear-point and names a god.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target ally stack · Ally rolls its maximum damage through the current and next round.
rows.lore: A priest touches a spear-point and names a god. For a little while every blow lands as if aimed by that god’s own hand.

rows.name: Far Sight
rows.where: Spellbook; Adventure map cast buttons; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Far Sight: an eye opening over a map. Shepherds’ magic: look at a hill long enough and you can see what grazes on its far side.
rows.details: Adventure · 5 mana · target known tile · Adventure only: reveal radius 2 around a known tile until next dawn. · expanded content
rows.lore: Shepherds’ magic: look at a hill long enough and you can see what grazes on its far side.

rows.name: Hearthlight
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Hearthlight: a warm light closing a wound. A glow like the fire of home, carried into the field.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target ally stack · Heal up to 12 + 4 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection. · expanded content
rows.lore: A glow like the fire of home, carried into the field. Wounds close a little, as they do when a mother is near.

rows.name: Ill Omen
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Ill Omen: a thread being cut short, a weapon dulled. Every army has a soldier who sees a crow on the left and loses heart.
rows.details: Battle · 5 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack rolls its minimum damage through the current and next round (a Blessing on it cancels out). · expanded content
rows.lore: Every army has a soldier who sees a crow on the left and loses heart. The spell finds that soldier in every rank at once and makes him right.

rows.name: Shield of Faith
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Shield of Faith: a shield wall turning a blade. Priests of every road-shrine teach the same prayer: not for victory, only that the next blow land a little lighter.
rows.details: Battle · 5 mana · target ally stack · Ally takes ×0.8 damage from melee strikes through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Priests of every road-shrine teach the same prayer: not for victory, only that the next blow land a little lighter. Soldiers say it under their breath before the lines meet.

rows.name: Spark
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Spark: a bolt or burst striking one target. The first thing every apprentice learns: a crack of light between two fingers, thrown hard.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack takes 10 + 5 × Power direct damage.
rows.lore: The first thing every apprentice learns: a crack of light between two fingers, thrown hard. Masters never stop using it.

rows.name: Swiftness

rows.brief: Swiftness: winged light at a runner’s heels. Spoken over a soldier’s feet, it makes the ground feel like a downhill road.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target ally stack · Ally +2 Speed through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Spoken over a soldier’s feet, it makes the ground feel like a downhill road.

rows.name: War Cry
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: War Cry: a weapon wreathed in a golden aura. A shout that is half prayer, half threat.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target ally stack · Ally +3 Attack through the current and next round.
rows.lore: A shout that is half prayer, half threat. Soldiers who hear it remember why they came.

rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target ally stack · Ally +3 Defense through the current and next round.

rows.name: Renewal
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Renewal: healing light falling like rain over an army. Springtime, called down for a moment over a battlefield.
rows.details: Battle · 12 mana · target friendly army · The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 10 + 5 × Power HP (no resurrection). · expanded content
rows.lore: Springtime, called down for a moment over a battlefield. It cannot bring back the dead, but it remembers the living.

rows.name: Starfall
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Starfall: fire or stars falling over an enemy army. On the night the old gods quarrelled, stars fell on both their armies.
rows.details: Battle · 14 mana · target enemy army · Every enemy stack takes 10 + 4 × Power damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: On the night the old gods quarrelled, stars fell on both their armies. Astronomers learned to ask for a few more — but only over the enemy.

rows.name: Bramble Snare
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Bramble Snare: winged light at a runner’s heels. Hawthorn is the fairies’ tree; cut it and it takes revenge.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy −2 Speed through the current round (never below 1). · expanded content
rows.lore: Hawthorn is the fairies’ tree; cut it and it takes revenge. The druids simply ask it to reach for the enemy’s ankles.

rows.name: Cauldron of the Dagda
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Cauldron of the Dagda: a warm light closing a wound. No one ever left the Dagda’s cauldron hungry.
rows.details: Battle · 7 mana · target ally stack · Heal up to 25 + 6 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection. · expanded content
rows.lore: No one ever left the Dagda’s cauldron hungry. A ladle of its broth, summoned to the field, mends what hunger and steel have opened.

rows.name: Glamour
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Glamour: a weapon wreathed in a golden aura. The Fair Folk’s favourite trick: make a sword look like a stick, a captain like a fool.
rows.details: Battle · 6 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy −3 Attack through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: The Fair Folk’s favourite trick: make a sword look like a stick, a captain like a fool. The enemy forgets how to fight.

rows.name: Mist of Manannán
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Mist of Manannán: a banner of light over a whole army. The sea god hides his islands behind a cloak of mist.
rows.details: Battle · 11 mana · target enemy army · Every enemy stack −2 Speed through the current and next round (never below 1). · expanded content
rows.lore: The sea god hides his islands behind a cloak of mist. Druids borrow a corner of it, and the enemy marches in circles.

rows.name: Wild Hunt
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Wild Hunt: an explosion spreading over a small area. Hounds, horns and riders out of the storm.
rows.details: Battle · 13 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 25 + 9 × Power damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: Hounds, horns and riders out of the storm. Whatever the Hunt passes over is never quite the same.

rows.name: Ankh of Renewal
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Ankh of Renewal: a warm light closing a wound. The key of life, held to a wound.
rows.details: Battle · 4 mana · target ally stack · Heal up to 15 + 5 × Power of the front creature’s missing HP; no resurrection. · expanded content
rows.lore: The key of life, held to a wound. Temple healers say the ankh does not heal — it only reminds the body what it was.

rows.name: Eye of Horus
rows.where: Spellbook; Adventure map cast buttons; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Eye of Horus: an eye opening over a map. The falcon god lost an eye fighting for his father’s throne; it was healed and became a charm of seeing.
rows.details: Adventure · 8 mana · target known tile · Adventure only: reveal radius 5 around a known tile until next dawn. · expanded content
rows.lore: The falcon god lost an eye fighting for his father’s throne; it was healed and became a charm of seeing.

rows.name: Wrath of Sekhmet
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Wrath of Sekhmet: a bolt or burst striking one target. The lioness once nearly devoured mankind and was calmed only with red beer.
rows.details: Battle · 8 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack takes 22 + 9 × Power direct damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: The lioness once nearly devoured mankind and was calmed only with red beer. Her priests can still wake a little of that rage — and point it.

rows.name: Balance of Ma’at
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Balance of Ma’at: healing light falling like rain over an army. On the scale of judgement a heart is weighed against a feather.
rows.details: Battle · 13 mana · target friendly army · The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 12 + 6 × Power HP (no resurrection). · expanded content
rows.lore: On the scale of judgement a heart is weighed against a feather. Ma’at restores what was taken unjustly — and in battle, much is.

rows.name: Scarab Swarm
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Scarab Swarm: an explosion spreading over a small area. The scarab rolls the sun across the sky.
rows.details: Battle · 10 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 15 + 6 × Power damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: The scarab rolls the sun across the sky. When angered, a thousand of them roll over whatever stands in the way.

rows.name: Hoplon Wall
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Hoplon Wall: a shield wall turning a blade. Each round shield covers the neighbour’s left side; the line stands or falls together.
rows.details: Battle · 5 mana · target ally stack · Ally takes ×0.75 damage from melee strikes through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Each round shield covers the neighbour’s left side; the line stands or falls together. The spell locks the shields edge to edge as if one smith had forged them all.

rows.name: Apollo’s Arrow
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Apollo’s Arrow: a bolt or burst striking one target. The far-shooting god’s arrows brought plague to the proud and light to the faithful.
rows.details: Battle · 8 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack takes 20 + 8 × Power direct damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: The far-shooting god’s arrows brought plague to the proud and light to the faithful. His priests ask only for one arrow, and aim it themselves.

rows.name: Wings of Hermes
rows.where: Spellbook; Adventure map cast buttons; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Wings of Hermes: a road unrolling under winged feet. The messenger of the gods never walked when he could run, and never ran when he could fly.
rows.details: Adventure · 7 mana · target self · Adventure only: the caster gains 150 movement points today. · expanded content
rows.lore: The messenger of the gods never walked when he could run, and never ran when he could fly. Heralds who honour him find the road shorter.

rows.name: Aegis
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Aegis: a banner of light over a whole army. The goatskin shield of the sky-father, lent to his daughter of wisdom.
rows.details: Battle · 9 mana · target friendly army · Every friendly stack +2 Defense through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: The goatskin shield of the sky-father, lent to his daughter of wisdom. Its shadow over an army turns aside every second blow.

rows.name: Thunderclap
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Thunderclap: an explosion spreading over a small area. The noise of the king of the gods losing his temper.
rows.details: Battle · 12 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 20 + 8 × Power damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: The noise of the king of the gods losing his temper. Anyone close enough to hear it is close enough to be hurt.

rows.name: Kitsune-bi
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Kitsune-bi: a bolt or burst striking one target. Fox-fire drifts over the rice paddies on autumn nights.
rows.details: Battle · 5 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack takes 12 + 5 × Power direct damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: Fox-fire drifts over the rice paddies on autumn nights. Travellers who follow it are lost; enemies who are followed by it burn.

rows.name: Blossom Veil
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Blossom Veil: a shield of light in front of a warrior. Cherry blossoms fall for only a few days.
rows.details: Battle · 6 mana · target ally stack · Ally +5 Defense through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Cherry blossoms fall for only a few days. While they fall, nothing sharp seems to reach the one they cover.

rows.name: Mirror of Yata
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Mirror of Yata: arrows deflected by a dome of light. A mirror once drew the sun goddess out of her cave.
rows.details: Battle · 7 mana · target ally stack · Ally takes ×0.5 damage from ranged strikes through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: A mirror once drew the sun goddess out of her cave. Its reflection, cast over a company, turns arrows aside like light from polished bronze.

rows.name: Divine Wind
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Divine Wind: a banner of light over a whole army. A wind sent by the gods once scattered an invading fleet.
rows.details: Battle · 8 mana · target friendly army · Every friendly stack +2 Speed through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: A wind sent by the gods once scattered an invading fleet. Called over an army, it pushes every soldier forward.

rows.name: Raijin’s Drums
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Raijin’s Drums: fire or stars falling over an enemy army. The thunder god beats a ring of drums across the sky.
rows.details: Battle · 14 mana · target enemy army · Every enemy stack takes 12 + 5 × Power damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: The thunder god beats a ring of drums across the sky. When his shrine-maidens dance, he sometimes beats them over the enemy’s camp.

rows.name: Jaguar Spirit
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Jaguar Spirit: a weapon wreathed in a golden aura. The jaguar hunts by night and by surprise.
rows.details: Battle · 5 mana · target ally stack · Ally +4 Attack through the current round. · expanded content
rows.lore: The jaguar hunts by night and by surprise. Warriors who wear its pelt call its spirit into their arms for one leap.

rows.name: Rain of Tlaloc
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Rain of Tlaloc: healing light falling like rain over an army. The rain god keeps four jars: one waters the maize, the others bring frost, drought and blight.
rows.details: Battle · 8 mana · target friendly army · The front creature of every friendly stack heals up to 8 + 4 × Power HP (no resurrection). · expanded content
rows.lore: The rain god keeps four jars: one waters the maize, the others bring frost, drought and blight. His priests pray only for the first.

rows.name: Smoking Mirror
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Smoking Mirror: a weapon wreathed in a golden aura. Tezcatlipoca’s obsidian mirror shows each man his own death.
rows.details: Battle · 7 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy −4 Attack through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Tezcatlipoca’s obsidian mirror shows each man his own death. Those who glimpse it fight like men already beaten.

rows.name: Fifth Sun
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Fifth Sun: a banner of light over a whole army. Four suns have died and the fifth is kept alive by sacrifice.
rows.details: Battle · 12 mana · target friendly army · Every friendly stack +3 Attack through the current round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Four suns have died and the fifth is kept alive by sacrifice. For one round, every warrior burns with its light.

rows.name: Obsidian Rain
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Obsidian Rain: an explosion spreading over a small area. Volcanic glass falls like hail from a sky the colour of smoke.
rows.details: Battle · 11 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack and every enemy stack beside it take 15 + 7 × Power damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: Volcanic glass falls like hail from a sky the colour of smoke. Priests say the mountain is only returning what was taken from it.

rows.name: Rune of Tyr
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Rune of Tyr: a weapon wreathed in a golden aura. Tyr gave his hand to bind the wolf.
rows.details: Battle · 5 mana · target ally stack · Ally +4 Attack through the current round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Tyr gave his hand to bind the wolf. Warriors cut his arrow-rune on their blades and ask him for one honest stroke.

rows.name: Frost Breath
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Frost Breath: winged light at a runner’s heels. The breath of the frost giants, who were here before the gods.
rows.details: Battle · 6 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy −3 Speed through the current and next round (never below 1). · expanded content
rows.lore: The breath of the frost giants, who were here before the gods. Joints stiffen, feet freeze to the ground.

rows.name: The Norns’ Thread
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: The Norns’ Thread: a thread being cut short, a weapon dulled. At the root of the world-tree three women spin every life.
rows.details: Battle · 7 mana · target enemy stack · Enemy stack rolls its minimum damage through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: At the root of the world-tree three women spin every life. A völva who knows the right song can make them shorten one thread — for a little while.

rows.name: Berserkergang
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Berserkergang: a banner of light over a whole army. Bear-shirted warriors who bite their shields and feel no wounds.
rows.details: Battle · 9 mana · target friendly army · Every friendly stack +2 Attack through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Bear-shirted warriors who bite their shields and feel no wounds. The spell spreads their madness through the ranks — briefly.

rows.name: Gjallarhorn
rows.where: Spellbook; Battle spell choice (when several can be cast); Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Gjallarhorn: a banner of light over a whole army. Heimdall will blow the horn once, at the end of all things.
rows.details: Battle · 12 mana · target enemy army · Every enemy stack −2 Attack through the current and next round. · expanded content
rows.lore: Heimdall will blow the horn once, at the end of all things. Its echo, called up by a skald, is enough to make an enemy feel that the end has come.

sections.title: Artifacts
sections.intro: 88 artifacts. The paper doll shows the item's own icon in its slot; until it exists the slot shows a glyph for the artifact kind (`ARTIFACT_KIND_GLYPH`). Rarity is shown by the socket frame, so the icon itself needs no frame.

rows.name: Boiled-leather Jerkin
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Boiled-leather Jerkin — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Ox-hide boiled in wax until it is hard as wood.
rows.details: treasure · +1 commander Defense. · expanded content
rows.lore: Ox-hide boiled in wax until it is hard as wood. It turns a glancing blade and costs a week’s wages.

rows.name: Lacquered Ō-yoroi
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Lacquered Ō-yoroi — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Hundreds of lacquered scales laced with silk in the colours of a house.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Defense and +1 morale. · set: Treasures of Takamagahara · expanded content
rows.lore: Hundreds of lacquered scales laced with silk in the colours of a house. Soldiers recognise the colours across a field and stand firmer.

rows.name: Linen Cuirass
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Linen Cuirass — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Layers of linen glued and stitched until they are as stiff as wood.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Defense.
rows.lore: Layers of linen glued and stitched until they are as stiff as wood. Cheaper than bronze and cooler in summer.

rows.name: Mail of the Einherjar
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Mail of the Einherjar — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The chosen dead fight every day in the hall of the slain and are whole again by evening.
rows.details: major · +3 commander Defense. · set: Arms of the Einherjar · expanded content
rows.lore: The chosen dead fight every day in the hall of the slain and are whole again by evening. Their mail mends with them.

rows.name: Quilted Cotton Armor
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Quilted Cotton Armor — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Two fingers of salt-hardened cotton, stitched tight.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Defense. · expanded content
rows.lore: Two fingers of salt-hardened cotton, stitched tight. Conquerors from over the sea laughed at it, then traded their steel for it.

rows.name: Scale Hauberk
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Scale Hauberk — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Overlapping bronze scales on a leather shirt, like the skin of a river serpent.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Defense.
rows.lore: Overlapping bronze scales on a leather shirt, like the skin of a river serpent.

rows.name: Scarab-scale Corselet
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Scarab-scale Corselet — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Bronze scales shaped like beetles that roll the sun across the sky.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Defense and +1 mana at dawn. · set: Regalia of the Two Lands · expanded content
rows.lore: Bronze scales shaped like beetles that roll the sun across the sky. The corselet is warm at dawn, as if it knows.

rows.name: Jaguar-pelt Cape
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Jaguar-pelt Cape — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Only a warrior who has taken four captives may wear the jaguar.
rows.details: major · Tier 1–3 creatures +1 Attack in battle. · expanded content
rows.lore: Only a warrior who has taken four captives may wear the jaguar. Young soldiers fight harder near one, hoping to earn their own.

rows.name: Nemean Lionskin
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Nemean Lionskin — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. No blade could cut the lion of Nemea; the hero strangled it and flayed it with its own claws.
rows.details: relic · +3 commander Defense. Unique. · expanded content
rows.lore: No blade could cut the lion of Nemea; the hero strangled it and flayed it with its own claws. The pelt still turns steel.

rows.name: Raven-feather Cloak
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Raven-feather Cloak — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The battle-crow goddess flies over every field before the fighting.
rows.details: minor · +10% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: The battle-crow goddess flies over every field before the fighting. A cloak of her feathers makes the road feel like flight.

rows.name: Wanderer’s Grey Cloak
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Wanderer’s Grey Cloak — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A broad-brimmed traveller in a grey cloak asks for a seat by every fire and listens more than he speaks.
rows.details: major · +2 hexes of vision and +5% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: A broad-brimmed traveller in a grey cloak asks for a seat by every fire and listens more than he speaks. Some say he leaves his cloak behind for those who listen too.

rows.name: Waxed Travel Cloak
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Waxed Travel Cloak — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Wool rubbed with beeswax so the rain runs off.
rows.details: treasure · +5% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: Wool rubbed with beeswax so the rain runs off. A dry rider rides longer.

rows.name: Wayfarer’s Cloak
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Wayfarer’s Cloak — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A heavy travelling cloak with deep pockets and a hood that keeps out rain from any direction.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Defense and +1 hex of vision. Wayfarer’s Kit. · set: Wayfarer’s Kit · expanded content
rows.lore: A heavy travelling cloak with deep pockets and a hood that keeps out rain from any direction.

rows.name: Boots of the Long Road
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Boots of the Long Road — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Cobbled for a pilgrim who swore to visit every shrine of every god.
rows.details: major · +15% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: Cobbled for a pilgrim who swore to visit every shrine of every god. He made it, they say, and the boots outlived him.

rows.name: Scribe’s Papyrus Sandals
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Scribe’s Papyrus Sandals — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Woven reed sandals of the temple scribes, who walked between the granaries counting everything.
rows.details: treasure · +1 commander Knowledge and +5% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: Woven reed sandals of the temple scribes, who walked between the granaries counting everything. Light, quiet and quick.

rows.name: Skis of Ullr
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Skis of Ullr — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The god of the hunt crosses the winter faster on his skis than a horse on summer roads.
rows.details: major · +15% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: The god of the hunt crosses the winter faster on his skis than a horse on summer roads. He lends them to anyone who swears by his ring.

rows.name: Tengu Geta
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Tengu Geta — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Tall one-toothed sandals of the mountain goblins, who taught swordsmanship to a boy in the forest.
rows.details: minor · +10% daily land movement and +1 hex of vision. · expanded content
rows.lore: Tall one-toothed sandals of the mountain goblins, who taught swordsmanship to a boy in the forest. Wearers walk the ridges as if on a road.

rows.name: Wayfarer’s Boots
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Wayfarer’s Boots — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Boots resoled so many times that nothing of the first pair remains — except, perhaps, the luck.
rows.details: minor · +10% daily land movement. Wayfarer’s Kit. · set: Wayfarer’s Kit · expanded content
rows.lore: Boots resoled so many times that nothing of the first pair remains — except, perhaps, the luck.

rows.name: Winged Sandals
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Winged Sandals — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Sandals with small wings at the heel, of the kind the messenger god wears.
rows.details: minor · +10% daily land movement.
rows.lore: Sandals with small wings at the heel, of the kind the messenger god wears. These are a mortal smith’s copy, and almost as good.

rows.name: Boar-crested Helm
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Boar-crested Helm — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A bronze boar rides the crest, bristles raised.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Defense. · expanded content
rows.lore: A bronze boar rides the crest, bristles raised. Northern smiths believed the boar watched over a sleeping warrior and woke him before an ambush.

rows.name: Cap of Darkness
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Cap of Darkness — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Made by the Cyclopes for the lord of the dead, it hides its wearer from every eye.
rows.details: major · +2 hexes of adventure vision and +1 Luck. · set: Gear of Perseus · expanded content
rows.lore: Made by the Cyclopes for the lord of the dead, it hides its wearer from every eye. A hero who wears it sees much and is seldom seen.

rows.name: Copper Circlet
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Copper Circlet — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A plain band hammered from one sheet of copper.
rows.details: treasure · +1 commander Knowledge. · expanded content
rows.lore: A plain band hammered from one sheet of copper. Students wear it to keep their hair — and, they say, their thoughts — in place.

rows.name: Crested Helm
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Crested Helm — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A bronze helm with a horsehair crest that makes a man look a head taller in the front rank.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Defense. Panoply of the Phalanx. · set: Panoply of the Phalanx · expanded content
rows.lore: A bronze helm with a horsehair crest that makes a man look a head taller in the front rank.

rows.name: Crown of Counsel
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Crown of Counsel — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A crown given to a queen who never made a decision without hearing the poorest of her people first.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Spell Power and +1 Knowledge.
rows.lore: A crown given to a queen who never made a decision without hearing the poorest of her people first.

rows.name: Dragon Kabuto
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Dragon Kabuto — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A lacquered helmet with a gilded dragon between its horns.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Attack and +1 Defense. · set: Treasures of Takamagahara · expanded content
rows.lore: A lacquered helmet with a gilded dragon between its horns. It was made for a general who never once turned his back on a battle.

rows.name: Mistletoe Crown
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Mistletoe Crown — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Cut from an oak with a golden sickle on the sixth night of the moon.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Knowledge. · expanded content
rows.lore: Cut from an oak with a golden sickle on the sixth night of the moon. Druids wear it when they must remember everything at once.

rows.name: Nemes of Ra
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Nemes of Ra — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The striped headcloth of kings, gold and lapis for the sun and the night sky.
rows.details: major · +1 commander Spell Power and +1 Knowledge. · set: Regalia of the Two Lands · expanded content
rows.lore: The striped headcloth of kings, gold and lapis for the sun and the night sky. Whoever wears it speaks with the authority of both.

rows.name: Quetzal War Crown
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Quetzal War Crown — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Green plumes of the sacred bird, worth more than gold.
rows.details: major · +1 commander Attack and +1 morale. · set: Gifts of the Feathered Serpent · expanded content
rows.lore: Green plumes of the sacred bird, worth more than gold. A captain who wears them is seen from across the battlefield — that is the point.

rows.name: Seer’s Circlet
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Seer’s Circlet — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A thin silver band worn by oracles, who see further with their eyes closed.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Spell Power.
rows.lore: A thin silver band worn by oracles, who see further with their eyes closed.

rows.name: Sun Diadem
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Sun Diadem — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A diadem of gold rays, worn by a priest-king who was the sun’s representative on earth.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Spell Power. Regalia of the Sun King. · set: Regalia of the Sun King · expanded content
rows.lore: A diadem of gold rays, worn by a priest-king who was the sun’s representative on earth.

rows.name: Bronze Standard
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Bronze Standard — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A bronze eagle on an ash pole.
rows.details: minor · +1 morale for the army.
rows.lore: A bronze eagle on an ash pole. Where it stands, the line stands.

rows.name: Cauldron of Plenty
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Cauldron of Plenty — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The second treasure of the gods of Ireland.
rows.details: relic · After a won battle each stack regains 10% of its losses; +1 morale. Unique. · set: Treasures of the Tuatha Dé · expanded content
rows.lore: The second treasure of the gods of Ireland. It fed every company that came to it, and none went away unsatisfied.

rows.name: Champion’s Banner
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Champion’s Banner — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A tattered banner whose emblem has faded.
rows.details: minor · +1 morale for the army. Relics of the Fallen Champion. · set: Relics of the Fallen Champion · expanded content
rows.lore: A tattered banner whose emblem has faded. Soldiers still know what it means.

rows.name: Cornucopia
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Cornucopia — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The horn of the goat who nursed the king of the gods, broken off and filled forever.
rows.details: relic · +200 Gold, +1 Wood and +1 Stone per day. Unique. · expanded content
rows.lore: The horn of the goat who nursed the king of the gods, broken off and filled forever. Armies that carry it never forage.

rows.name: Djed Amulet
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Djed Amulet — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The backbone of the god who died and rose again.
rows.details: major · After a won battle each stack regains 10% of its losses (floored). · expanded content
rows.lore: The backbone of the god who died and rose again. Soldiers carry it so that what falls may stand up.

rows.name: Kibisis
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Kibisis — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The silver satchel that carried the monster’s head.
rows.details: minor · +10% battle experience. · set: Gear of Perseus · expanded content
rows.lore: The silver satchel that carried the monster’s head. Whatever goes into it — trophies, stories, lessons — comes out larger.

rows.name: Knucklebone Charm
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Knucklebone Charm — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Five sheep knucklebones from a game soldiers play in camp.
rows.details: minor · +1 Luck for the army.
rows.lore: Five sheep knucklebones from a game soldiers play in camp. Someone always wins; whoever carries these wins more often.

rows.name: Lamp of Prometheus
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Lamp of Prometheus — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A clay lamp lit, the story goes, from the coal the Titan stole for mankind.
rows.details: major · +2 mana at dawn and +1 commander Spell Power. · expanded content
rows.lore: A clay lamp lit, the story goes, from the coal the Titan stole for mankind. It has never gone out.

rows.name: Ogham Staves
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Ogham Staves — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Twenty letters cut as notches on yew staves, each a tree.
rows.details: major · +15% spell damage. · expanded content
rows.lore: Twenty letters cut as notches on yew staves, each a tree. Poets cast them to read fate and, when needed, to write it.

rows.name: Omamori Charm
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Omamori Charm — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A silk pouch from a shrine, holding a prayer no one may read.
rows.details: treasure · +1 Luck. · expanded content
rows.lore: A silk pouch from a shrine, holding a prayer no one may read. Opening it would let the luck out.

rows.name: Scholar’s Oil Lamp
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Scholar’s Oil Lamp — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A small clay lamp for reading at night.
rows.details: treasure · +1 mana at dawn. · expanded content
rows.lore: A small clay lamp for reading at night. A spellcaster who studies by it wakes with one more charm remembered.

rows.name: Star Compass
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Star Compass — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A needle that points not north but toward the nearest place worth seeing.
rows.details: minor · +2 hexes of adventure vision. Wayfarer’s Kit. · set: Wayfarer’s Kit · expanded content
rows.lore: A needle that points not north but toward the nearest place worth seeing.

rows.name: Stone of Fál
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Stone of Fál — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The third treasure: a stone that roars when the rightful king steps upon it.
rows.details: relic · +1 Luck and +1 commander Defense. Unique. · set: Treasures of the Tuatha Dé · expanded content
rows.lore: The third treasure: a stone that roars when the rightful king steps upon it. A fragment of it hums under the hand of a true leader.

rows.name: Sun-stone Codex
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Sun-stone Codex — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A folding book of bark paper that counts the days of five suns.
rows.details: major · +10% spell damage and +1 commander Spell Power. · expanded content
rows.lore: A folding book of bark paper that counts the days of five suns. Its reader knows which hour belongs to which god.

rows.name: Valkyrie’s Horn
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Valkyrie’s Horn — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The choosers of the slain drink from it before they ride.
rows.details: major · +1 morale and +10% battle experience. · set: Arms of the Einherjar · expanded content
rows.lore: The choosers of the slain drink from it before they ride. Warriors who hear it blown know they are being watched — and judged.

rows.name: Watchman’s Lantern
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Watchman’s Lantern — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A horn-paned lantern with a hood that throws its light forward.
rows.details: treasure · +1 hex of vision. · expanded content
rows.lore: A horn-paned lantern with a hood that throws its light forward. Night watches see farther, and so does the hero who carries one.

rows.name: Barding of the Hippeis
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Barding of the Hippeis — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Bronze chest-plate for the horse of a cavalry noble.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Defense and +5% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: Bronze chest-plate for the horse of a cavalry noble. Expensive, heavy, and much admired at festivals.

rows.name: Horseshoe of Sleipnir
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Horseshoe of Sleipnir — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A shoe thrown by the eight-legged horse as it leapt the gate of the dead.
rows.details: relic · +20% daily land movement. Unique. · expanded content
rows.lore: A shoe thrown by the eight-legged horse as it leapt the gate of the dead. Any mount that wears it forgets what tiredness was.

rows.name: Saddle of the Wild Hunt
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Saddle of the Wild Hunt — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. On storm nights the Hunt rides across the sky.
rows.details: major · +10% daily land movement and +1 commander Attack. · expanded content
rows.lore: On storm nights the Hunt rides across the sky. A saddle dropped from it still smells of rain and wants to gallop.

rows.name: Solar Chariot Harness
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Solar Chariot Harness — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Gilded straps from the chariot of a king who drove into battle under the sun-disc.
rows.details: major · +10% daily land movement and +1 morale. · expanded content
rows.lore: Gilded straps from the chariot of a king who drove into battle under the sun-disc. His soldiers followed the glint.

rows.name: Swift Saddle
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Swift Saddle — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A light saddle of the steppe riders, who are born in the saddle and never quite leave it.
rows.details: minor · +15% daily land movement.
rows.lore: A light saddle of the steppe riders, who are born in the saddle and never quite leave it.

rows.name: Woven Saddle Blanket
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Woven Saddle Blanket — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Thick wool in the colours of the weaver’s village.
rows.details: treasure · +5% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: Thick wool in the colours of the weaver’s village. A horse that does not chafe walks an extra hour.

rows.name: Champion’s Torc
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Champion’s Torc — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A champion’s gold neck-ring, worn smooth by years of fighting.
rows.details: minor · +1 Luck for the army. Relics of the Fallen Champion. · set: Relics of the Fallen Champion · expanded content
rows.lore: A champion’s gold neck-ring, worn smooth by years of fighting.

rows.name: Clay Votive Amulet
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Clay Votive Amulet — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A thumb-sized figure of the household god, fired in a potter’s kiln and blessed at the town shrine.
rows.details: treasure · +1 morale. · expanded content
rows.lore: A thumb-sized figure of the household god, fired in a potter’s kiln and blessed at the town shrine. Soldiers touch it before every charge.

rows.name: Heart Scarab
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Heart Scarab — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A green stone beetle laid over the heart of the dead, inscribed: “Do not stand against me.” The living wear it so their courage does not testify against them.
rows.details: minor · +2 mana at dawn. · expanded content
rows.lore: A green stone beetle laid over the heart of the dead, inscribed: “Do not stand against me.” The living wear it so their courage does not testify against them.

rows.name: Jade Pectoral
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Jade Pectoral — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Green jade is the breath of life.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Spell Power. · set: Gifts of the Feathered Serpent · expanded content
rows.lore: Green jade is the breath of life. Priest-kings wore a carved plaque over the heart to keep their spirit strong in the presence of gods.

rows.name: Link of Brísingamen
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Link of Brísingamen — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. One link of the necklace four dwarves made for the goddess of love and war.
rows.details: major · +1 Luck and +1 commander Spell Power. · expanded content
rows.lore: One link of the necklace four dwarves made for the goddess of love and war. It still glows faintly, like a hearth seen through snow.

rows.name: String of Magatama
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: String of Magatama — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Curved jewels like claws or crescent moons, strung on silk.
rows.details: major · +1 Luck and +1 hex of adventure vision. · set: Treasures of Takamagahara · expanded content
rows.lore: Curved jewels like claws or crescent moons, strung on silk. They were offered to the sun goddess when the world went dark.

rows.name: Torc of the High King
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Torc of the High King — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A twisted gold collar no one may wear who has run from a fight.
rows.details: major · +1 morale and +1 commander Defense. · expanded content
rows.lore: A twisted gold collar no one may wear who has run from a fight. The warband knows the rule; seeing it on their leader steadies them.

rows.name: Andvari’s Ring
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Andvari’s Ring — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The dwarf Andvari cursed the ring when it was taken from him: it would bring gold and ruin to all who owned it.
rows.details: major · +500 Gold per day, −1 Luck. · expanded content
rows.lore: The dwarf Andvari cursed the ring when it was taken from him: it would bring gold and ruin to all who owned it. Many have decided the gold is worth it.

rows.name: Band of Insight
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Band of Insight — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A ring of plain iron, engraved inside with “Know yourself.”
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Knowledge.
rows.lore: A ring of plain iron, engraved inside with “Know yourself.”

rows.name: Bronze Seal Ring
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Bronze Seal Ring — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A signet cut with a spiral.
rows.details: treasure · +1 commander Spell Power. · expanded content
rows.lore: A signet cut with a spiral. Pressed into wax it seals a letter; pressed into a palm before a spell, its owner swears, it seals the spell tighter.

rows.name: Echo of Draupnir
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Echo of Draupnir — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Every ninth night the All-father’s ring drips eight rings as heavy as itself.
rows.details: major · +250 Gold per day. · expanded content
rows.lore: Every ninth night the All-father’s ring drips eight rings as heavy as itself. This is one of those — and it remembers the trick, a little.

rows.name: Fairy-ring Band
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Fairy-ring Band — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Woven from grass taken from inside a ring of mushrooms at dawn.
rows.details: minor · +1 Luck. · expanded content
rows.lore: Woven from grass taken from inside a ring of mushrooms at dawn. The Fair Folk are said to look kindly on whoever wears it — or at least to look elsewhere.

rows.name: Jade Ring of Tlaloc
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Jade Ring of Tlaloc — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Cool as rainwater even in the dry season.
rows.details: minor · +2 mana at dawn. · expanded content
rows.lore: Cool as rainwater even in the dry season. Priests wear it to keep their spirit from drying out during long fasts.

rows.name: Signet of Hermes
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Signet of Hermes — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A herald’s ring with a winged staff cut in carnelian.
rows.details: minor · +10% daily land movement. · expanded content
rows.lore: A herald’s ring with a winged staff cut in carnelian. Gatekeepers wave its bearer through; roads seem to agree.

rows.name: Sun Signet
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Sun Signet — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The priest-king’s seal: a sun pressed into wax made any order law.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Knowledge. Regalia of the Sun King. · set: Regalia of the Sun King · expanded content
rows.lore: The priest-king’s seal: a sun pressed into wax made any order law.

rows.name: Warding Token
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Warding Token — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A clay token stamped with a centaur’s hoof, found in a cache in the hills.
rows.details: relic · +1 commander Defense. A token recovered from the centaur cache.
rows.lore: A clay token stamped with a centaur’s hoof, found in a cache in the hills. Shepherds say it keeps wolves — and arrows — away.

rows.name: Watcher’s Ring
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Watcher’s Ring — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A ring set with a stone like an eye.
rows.details: minor · +2 hexes of adventure vision.
rows.lore: A ring set with a stone like an eye. The night watch passes it from sentry to sentry.

rows.name: Bronze Buckler
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Bronze Buckler — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A small fist-shield sold in every market from the harbours to the mountains.
rows.details: treasure · +1 commander Defense. · expanded content
rows.lore: A small fist-shield sold in every market from the harbours to the mountains. Not glorious, but often enough.

rows.name: Eagle Chimalli
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Eagle Chimalli — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A round shield faced with eagle feathers and a gold rim.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Defense and +1 morale. · set: Gifts of the Feathered Serpent · expanded content
rows.lore: A round shield faced with eagle feathers and a gold rim. The eagle fights the sun’s enemies every dawn; its warriors fight the empire’s.

rows.name: Phalanx Aspis
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Phalanx Aspis — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A great round shield, carried on the left arm to cover the neighbour as much as oneself.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Defense. Panoply of the Phalanx. · set: Panoply of the Phalanx · expanded content
rows.lore: A great round shield, carried on the left arm to cover the neighbour as much as oneself.

rows.name: Polished Bronze Shield
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Polished Bronze Shield — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Polished until it was a mirror, so its bearer could look at what must not be looked at.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Defense and +1 hex of vision. · set: Gear of Perseus · expanded content
rows.lore: Polished until it was a mirror, so its bearer could look at what must not be looked at. Scouts use it to see around corners.

rows.name: Shield of the Medjay
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Shield of the Medjay — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Cowhide over a wooden frame, carried by the desert scouts who policed the tombs of kings.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Defense and +1 Attack. · expanded content
rows.lore: Cowhide over a wooden frame, carried by the desert scouts who policed the tombs of kings. Light enough to run with, strong enough to stop a spear.

rows.name: Shieldmaiden’s Round Shield
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Shieldmaiden’s Round Shield — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Painted linden-wood with an iron boss.
rows.details: major · +1 commander Defense; tier 1–2 creatures +1 Defense in battle. · set: Arms of the Einherjar · expanded content
rows.lore: Painted linden-wood with an iron boss. Shieldmaidens held the front of the wall so the young warriors behind them could learn.

rows.name: Targe of the Fianna
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Targe of the Fianna — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. No one joined the war-band of the Fianna until they had stood in a pit with only a shield and a hazel stick, and nine warriors had cast spears at them.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Defense. · expanded content
rows.lore: No one joined the war-band of the Fianna until they had stood in a pit with only a shield and a hazel stick, and nine warriors had cast spears at them.

rows.name: Bronze Spear
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Bronze Spear — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. An honest spear of ash and bronze, the weapon of every citizen soldier.
rows.details: minor · +1 commander Attack.
rows.lore: An honest spear of ash and bronze, the weapon of every citizen soldier.

rows.name: Champion’s Blade
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Champion’s Blade — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The sword of a champion whose name is lost.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Attack. Relics of the Fallen Champion. · set: Relics of the Fallen Champion · expanded content
rows.lore: The sword of a champion whose name is lost. It still remembers every duel.

rows.name: Harpe of Perseus
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Harpe of Perseus — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A sickle-sword given by the god of messengers, sharp enough to take the head of a monster whose gaze turned men to stone.
rows.details: major · +3 commander Attack. · set: Gear of Perseus · expanded content
rows.lore: A sickle-sword given by the god of messengers, sharp enough to take the head of a monster whose gaze turned men to stone.

rows.name: Iron-shod Spear
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Iron-shod Spear — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Ash shaft, iron point, a smith’s mark on the socket.
rows.details: treasure · +1 commander Attack. · expanded content
rows.lore: Ash shaft, iron point, a smith’s mark on the socket. The first weapon of every militia and the last one a veteran gives up.

rows.name: Khopesh of Set
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Khopesh of Set — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A hooked bronze blade of the red desert’s god — storm, strength and confusion.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Attack and +1 Spell Power. · set: Regalia of the Two Lands · expanded content
rows.lore: A hooked bronze blade of the red desert’s god — storm, strength and confusion. It strikes from angles a shield does not expect.

rows.name: Obsidian Macuahuitl
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Obsidian Macuahuitl — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A wooden war-club edged with blades of volcanic glass sharper than any steel.
rows.details: major · +3 commander Attack. · expanded content
rows.lore: A wooden war-club edged with blades of volcanic glass sharper than any steel. Each blade is a fragment of the smoking mirror.

rows.name: Phalanx Spear
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Phalanx Spear — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Long, heavy, and meant to be held with a hundred others pointing the same way.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Attack. Panoply of the Phalanx. · set: Panoply of the Phalanx · expanded content
rows.lore: Long, heavy, and meant to be held with a hundred others pointing the same way.

rows.name: Rune-marked Sword
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Rune-marked Sword — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Its maker hammered his name into the blade in letters no other smith could read.
rows.details: major · +2 commander Attack and +1 Luck. · set: Arms of the Einherjar · expanded content
rows.lore: Its maker hammered his name into the blade in letters no other smith could read. It bends, springs back and never breaks.

rows.name: Spear of Lugh
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Spear of Lugh — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. One of four treasures the gods brought to Ireland.
rows.details: relic · +3 commander Attack and +1 morale. Unique. · set: Treasures of the Tuatha Dé · expanded content
rows.lore: One of four treasures the gods brought to Ireland. No battle was ever won against the one who held it.

rows.name: Storm God’s Tachi
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Storm God’s Tachi — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. The storm god found it in the tail of the eight-headed serpent he had slain.
rows.details: relic · +2 commander Attack, +1 Defense and +1 Luck. Unique. · expanded content
rows.lore: The storm god found it in the tail of the eight-headed serpent he had slain. It is said to part grass like wind and fire like water.

rows.name: Storm-iron Blade
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Storm-iron Blade — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. Forged from iron that fell from the sky in a thunderstorm.
rows.details: minor · +2 commander Attack.
rows.lore: Forged from iron that fell from the sky in a thunderstorm. It hums before a battle.

rows.name: Sun Scepter
rows.where: Hero screen (paper doll, backpack); Artifact merchant; Battle result loot; Encounter reward preview; Encyclopedia
rows.brief: Sun Scepter — draw the object alone, three-quarter view. A gold rod topped with a sun-disc.

rows.name: The Storm Beacon
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Melas holds the great beacon’s lens on the storm plateau. Choose a crossing, activate both relays to unseal the ward gate, defeat Melas and light the last beacon.

rows.name: Barrow Light
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Spring is two months late and Kaldvik’s barrow has cracked open. Raise and bind a watch from the barrow, clear the frozen ford and cut the headland rune again.

rows.name: The White Pack
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: A pack of white wolves cuts the south road to Birkaby, and it runs where the Grey Jarl tells it. Raise wolves of your own, cross the Varg-river, hunt the pack down and cut the wood’s rune.

rows.name: The Valkyrie’s Price
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Frost trolls hold the Valkyries’ aerie in the high fells. Break the ice-pass, free the aerie, win the trolls’ oath by gold or by force, choose Thor or Tyr and carry Battle Valkyries to the third rune.

rows.name: Ice on the Sound
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Only the Norns know the Grey Jarl’s oath. Raise Lindworms, take the ice-landing, light both way-cairns through the fog and read the water of the Norns’ Well — while a draugr crew walks the ice.

rows.name: The Jarl of Hvitstrand
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Jarl Ulfhild swore to keep the Grey Jarl’s winter for a frozen sea that keeps her rivals’ ships in harbour. Cross the Hvita, win a second god, take Hvitstrand from a living rival and break her oath.

rows.name: The Giants’ Refuge
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The Grey Jarl froze the giants of Hrimgard into the glacier to guard his road. Climb the glacier wall, break the ice-wardens, win the Jotnar’s oath and defeat Hrafn the Hollow at the Glacier Gate.

rows.name: Oathbreaker’s Hall
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The Grey Jarl waits in his hall on the oath-mound. Climb the plateau, cut both stones to open the barrow-gate, defeat the Jarl, decide the sword’s fate and seal the oath.

rows.name: The Ember Dawn
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: For nine mornings the sun has risen red and low and gone down again within the hour. Raise a temple guard in Abedju, clear the canal lock and sing the morning hymn at the Obelisk of the East.

rows.name: The Black Boar
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: A herd of black boars, fed and driven by the Hollow Lector’s men, roots up the west-bank fields of Nekheb. Raise jackals of your own, cross the river, hunt the herd down and reopen the Shrine of the Western Gate.

rows.name: The Sculptor’s Price
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: In the quarries above Edfu the tomb-servants have stopped working. Break the hired guard on the cliff road, free the sphinxes’ terrace, win the ushabti covenant — by the sculptor’s price or by force — and take a god for the long night ahead.

rows.name: The Drowned Library
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The House of Records at Per-Djehuty lies beyond the flooded marsh, behind a veil of grey mist. Raise river beasts, take the landing, light both pylon-fires to burn away the mist and read what the records say about the sun.

rows.name: The Red Vizier
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Paser, a vizier who crowned himself in the dusk, holds Per-Wadjet and the stela of the throne. Cross the river, take a second god, besiege his town and break the stela that names him king.

rows.name: The Phoenix Rookery
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The bennu birds, whose rising is the sun’s own, are caged in their rookery under the cliffs of Iunu. Break the jailers, accept the bennu covenant, raise firebirds of your own and defeat Hekaib at the rookery gate.

rows.name: The Twelfth Hour
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The barque of the sun is held in the Hall of the Coil, at the bottom of the night. Cross into the hours, open the gate with both horizon-stones, defeat Djedkhonsu and decide what becomes of the coiled dark.

rows.name: The Unlit Lantern
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: On the night of the festival of the dead, not one lantern in Kagaribi would light. Raise a fox retinue, clear the bamboo bridge and relight the great stone lantern on the pass.

rows.name: The Boar Lord
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: A giant boar and its herd run the rice terraces of Mizuhara and keep the spirits from the river lantern. Raise kappa of your own, cross the river, hunt the Boar Lord and relight the lantern of the mountain road.

rows.name: The Crow Monastery
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The bell of the Crow Monastery on Kumoyama has stopped. Break the ronin on the mountain road, free the oni of the red hall from their clay jailers, win the tengu covenant — by the abbot’s price or by force — and take a kami for the road ahead.

rows.name: The Spirit Sea
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The Hall of Mirrors stands on an island in the Spirit Sea, behind a fog that eats boats. Raise spider-women of your own, take the landing, ring both shrine bells to clear the fog and look into the mirrors for the Lantern-Eater’s home.

rows.name: The Iron Daimyo
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Lord Kurogane fences the wandering dead into his army and holds the Iron Castle and the Lantern of Oaths. Cross the river, take a second kami, besiege his castle and break the lantern that binds the dead to him.

rows.name: The Kirin Meadow
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The kirin, whose coming marks a just age, are penned in their high meadow by the Lantern-Eater’s jailers. Break the jailers, accept the kirin covenant, raise kirin of your own and defeat General Oboro at the meadow gate.

rows.name: The Last Torii
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The Lantern-Eater’s palace stands across the last stretch of the spirits’ road, behind the last torii. Cross the hills, light the sun stone and the moon stone, defeat Yamikage and decide what becomes of the road between the worlds.

rows.name: The Cold Hearth
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Beltane came and no fire would catch. Raise a war-band of pooka in Dún Caill, clear the ford of the alders and light the Beltane fire on the old stone.

rows.name: The Iron-Bristled Boar
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: A boar with bristles like iron nails leads a herd through the fields of Dún Bera and keeps the folk from the ogham stone at the ford. Raise hounds of your own, cross the river, hunt the boar and cut the summer ogham again.

rows.name: The Water-Horse Bargain
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The kelpies of Loch Eala have stopped coming to shore. Break the reavers on the hill road, free the banshees’ hill from the cairn-men, win the kelpie covenant — by the keeper’s bargain or by force — and take a god for the dark road ahead.

rows.name: The Hall Beneath the Waves
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The hall of the sea-folk lies beyond the islands, behind a mist that came with the raiders. Raise selkies of your own, take the landing, light both headland fires to burn away the mist and ask the sea-folk where the Withered King keeps the broken branch.

rows.name: The High Seat
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Fiachra took the high seat at the ford in the long winter and holds it with the Withered King’s help. Cross the river, take a second god, besiege his fort and overturn the inauguration stone that names him king.

rows.name: The Stags’ Wood
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The great horned stags of the deep wood are bound in iron by the Withered King’s jailers. Break the jailers, accept the stags’ covenant, raise stag spirits of your own and defeat Tadhg the Grey at the wood’s gate.

rows.name: The Door of the Mound
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The Withered King holds the broken silver branch in his hall inside the great mound. Cross the barrow-hills, use the summer stone and the winter stone to open the door, defeat Dubhghall and decide what becomes of the silver branch.

rows.name: The Cold Altar
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: On the night the years are bound, the new fire was never lit — someone put out the old one first. Raise a war-band of feathered serpents in Xochitla, clear the canoe ford and kindle the fire on the hill altar.

rows.name: The Black Jaguars
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: A pack of black jaguar spirits, loosed by the Night-Knife, hunts the cacao groves of Tepeyolo and guards the altar of the morning star. Raise jaguars of your own, cross the river, hunt the pack down and relight the altar.

rows.name: The House of Eagles
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The eagle warriors of Ocelotepec have stopped flying. Break the cultists on the mountain road, free the crocodiles’ cenote from the stone jailers, win the eagle covenant — by the elders’ price or by force — and take a god for the dark road ahead.

rows.name: The House of Bats
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The House of Bats stands on an island in the great lake, behind a smoke that came with the raiders’ canoes. Raise camazotz of your own, take the landing, light both lake altars to clear the smoke and ask the bats where the Night-Knife keeps the stolen fire.

rows.name: The Lord of Itzcalli
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: Tecuani, lord of Itzcalli, swore to the Night-Knife for the throne of the next age, and holds the road east. Cross the river, take a second god, besiege his city and break the stela of his oath.

rows.name: The Fire Mountain
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The fire serpents, whose coils carry flame across the sky, are chained in the crater of the fire mountain. Break the jailers, accept the serpents’ covenant, raise fire serpents of your own and defeat Mazatl at the crater gate.

rows.name: The Smoking Gate
rows.where: Campaign setup; Briefing; Debrief
rows.brief: The Night-Knife keeps the old fire in his obsidian palace inside the smoking mountain. Cross the ash-hills, light the morning-star stone and the evening-star stone to open the gate, defeat Itztli and decide what fire the next years are bound with.

rows.name: The Three Beacons
rows.where: Campaign setup
rows.brief: A storm has extinguished the three signal beacons protecting the coast of Asterion. Lead Alexios through three short linked missions to reconnect the coast before its settlements abandon one another.

rows.name: The Winter Oath
rows.where: Campaign setup
rows.brief: The winter did not end. Kaldvik’s barrow has opened, white wolves cut the roads and the Grey Jarl wants back the sword the seeress Hervor took from his mound. Lead Hervor through seven linked missions to bind the long winter — and decide what becomes of the oath.

rows.name: The Twelfth Hour
rows.where: Campaign setup
rows.brief: The sun has stopped below the horizon. Lead the lector priestess Seshet through seven linked missions — from the red dawns of Abedju down through the hours of the night — to free the barque of the sun from the Hollow Lector and the coiled dark.

rows.name: The Lantern Road
rows.where: Campaign setup
rows.brief: The lanterns that guide the dead home have gone dark. Lead the shrine diviner Akane through seven linked missions — from the unlit festival of Kagaribi to the last torii — to relight the spirits’ road and face the Lantern-Eater.

rows.name: The Silver Branch
rows.where: Campaign setup
rows.brief: The silver branch that opens the mounds has been broken, and the year has stuck in its dark half. Lead the druid Orla through seven linked missions — from the cold Beltane of Dún Caill to the door of the great mound — to turn the year and face the Withered King.

rows.name: The New Fire
rows.where: Campaign setup
rows.brief: The fire that binds the years was put out before it could be renewed, and the sun is fading. Lead the day-keeper Itzel through seven linked missions — from the cold altar of Xochitla to the smoking gate — to bind the years again and face the Night-Knife.
